conditions: One independent Eagle Eye reviewer received 77 clean baseline captures, device scale and arrival metadata. The reviewer had no fixture source, comparator plan, answer key, flagged rows, marked-up screenshots or repaired views. The submission was frozen before grading.
coverage: 24 physical pages, a separate Inbox arrival, three viewport profiles, plus before/after keyboard focus on the member page. All 20 seeded baseline causes were eligible. The grader checked the submission against the pre-existing key and the linked captures.
limit: This is a single screenshot-only pilot. The reviewer accepted the breadcrumb but missed its separate 2 px toolbar-gap defect, and identified the outer Archive shift without detecting the additional half-pixel mobile row inset. The two additional observations are supported visual findings outside the seed key.

findings.title: Keyboard focus is invisible
findings.reason: The unfocused and keyboard screenshots are identical, and the live Tab test records zero ring pixels.

findings.title: Compact imports hide the identifying suffix
findings.reason: The required suffix is missing on compact; the independent probe measures 433 px of content in 324 px.

findings.title: The archived-search confirmation is hard to read
findings.reason: The empty-state confirmation and measured 2.25 to 1 ratio match the paint case.

findings.title: Field desk details lose the section indicator
findings.reason: Additional wayfinding issue. Directly verified that the highlighted parent on the list loses its treatment on the related detail view.

findings.title: The compact chart scales its axes down to fine print
findings.reason: Additional readability issue. The compact screenshot shows axis labels with substantially smaller visible ink than the adjacent legend.

findings.title: Archive shifts the content start
findings.reason: Correct views, direction and 3 px outer-content shift on all measured widths.

findings.title: Returning to Inbox changes its position
findings.reason: Isolates the +2 px shift on an Inbox reached by the Archive link.

findings.title: Settings widens the shared sidebar
findings.reason: Separates the +4 px wide/tablet rail change from the stable local title inset.

findings.title: Compact Settings shifts the header actions
findings.reason: Correctly identifies a 2 px leftward mobile action shift.

findings.title: A selected tree item gets an extra level of indentation
findings.reason: Identifies the 4 px local indentation and preserved sibling rail.

findings.title: The Hydrology chip changes its internal gap
findings.reason: The repeated dot stays fixed while the chip label starts 2 px farther right.

findings.title: The filled plot symbol sits low
findings.reason: The repeated plot marks establish the filled glyph’s 2 px vertical offset.

findings.title: Entering a site changes the chart legend’s spacing
findings.reason: Correctly scopes the 2 px legend gap reduction to wide and tablet.

findings.title: The compact Sample header moves away from its values
findings.reason: Identifies the 2 px compact table-header shift against the data column.

findings.title: The itinerary day number drops in its date tile
findings.reason: Identifies the 2 px downward shift inside the fixed date tile on wide and tablet.

findings.title: Lina’s name steps away from the same avatar
findings.reason: Identifies the 3 px gap increase next to the same avatar.

findings.title: The first compact notification marker misses its timeline
findings.reason: Identifies the 1.5 px leftward shift at compact density.

findings.title: The valid title field’s helper is indented on New field note
findings.reason: Identifies the approximately 4 px helper inset and separates glyph bearings from layout.

findings.title: The Import footer action sits farther from the card edge
findings.reason: Identifies the same 3 px increase in trailing space on the affected widths.

findings.title: The compact empty-search query starts farther inside its field
findings.reason: Identifies the 3 px compact query inset and checks wide/tablet as controls.
